exposure: Cesarean hysterectomy for placenta accreta spectrum
Conservative management (leaving the placenta in situ) for placenta accreta spectrum
outcome: Transfusion of >4 units of packed red blood cells
Total estimated blood loss exceeding 3000 mL
cohort: Women with placenta accreta spectrum who underwent either cesarean hysterectomy or conservative management during cesarean delivery
finding: Among women with placenta accreta spectrum who underwent cesarean delivery, conservative management was associated with a lower risk of transfusion of >4 units of packed red blood cells within 6 months than cesarean hysterectomy.
